entries.summaryZh: 353年，罗马皇帝君士坦提乌斯二世在高卢的蒙斯塞琉古击败篡位者马格嫩提乌斯。马格嫩提乌斯自两年前穆尔萨大战失利后支持者不断流失，此战失利后其势力彻底崩溃，他本人自杀，内战结束，君士坦提乌斯二世成为帝国唯一的统治者，罗马帝国重归统一。
entries.summaryEn: In 353 Constantius II defeated the usurper Magnentius at Mons Seleucus in Gaul. Magnentius had been losing support since his defeat at Mursa Major two years earlier; after this battle his cause collapsed, he took his own life and Constantius became sole ruler of the Roman Empire.
entries.significanceZh: 蒙斯·塞琉古战役结束了罗马帝国353年的内战，使君士坦提乌斯二世成为唯一的奥古斯都。
entries.significanceEn: Mons Seleucus ended the Roman civil war of 353 and left Constantius II as sole Augustus of the empire.

Chinese Wikipedia has no article on this battle, so the citations are the English article and the Wikidata entity. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged from the structured record.

entries.summaryZh: 402年4月6日，斯提里科率西罗马军队在意大利波伦蒂亚迎击阿拉里克一世统率的西哥特人并获胜，迫使阿拉里克撤退。次年阿拉里克再战维罗纳又败，暂时退出意大利。此战是401年至403年哥特人首次入侵意大利的关键交战，意大利由此获得数年安宁。
entries.summaryEn: On 6 April 402 Stilicho's Roman army defeated Alaric I and his Visigoths at Pollentia in Italy and forced them to withdraw. Alaric fought again at Verona the next year and was beaten once more, leaving Italy in peace until his second invasion in 409.
entries.significanceZh: 波伦蒂亚战役遏止了西哥特人首次入侵意大利，为西罗马赢得数年喘息，也确立了斯提里科的军事声望。
entries.significanceEn: Pollentia checked the first Gothic invasion of Italy, gave the Western Roman Empire several years of respite and confirmed Stilicho's military standing.
entries.notesZh: 断代依据：英文维基记402年4月6日，维基数据P585同为402年4月6日，精度到日，本条只保留年份精度。语种缺口：中文维基百科尚无该条目，引用为英文条目与维基数据实体。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级不改动。

entries.summaryZh: 763年6月30日，拜占庭皇帝君士坦丁五世在色雷斯黑海沿岸的安基阿卢斯附近击败保加利亚汗特莱茨的军队。拜占庭舰队与陆军协同作战，保加利亚军溃败，特莱茨在此前后被内部反对者所杀。此役使拜占庭在此后数十年对保加利亚保持军事优势。
entries.summaryEn: On 30 June 763 the Byzantine emperor Constantine V defeated the Bulgarian army of khan Telets near Anchialus on the Black Sea coast of Thrace. The Byzantines coordinated their fleet with the land army, the Bulgarians broke and Telets was killed by his own people, leaving Byzantium dominant for decades.
entries.significanceZh: 安基阿卢斯战役确立了拜占庭在8世纪中叶对保加利亚的军事优势，巩固了君士坦丁五世的北方边境。
entries.significanceEn: Anchialus confirmed Byzantine military superiority over Bulgaria in the mid-eighth century and secured Constantine V's northern frontier.
entries.notesZh: 断代依据：英文维基记763年，维基数据P585为763年6月30日，精度到日，本条只保留年份精度。语种缺口：中文维基百科尚无该条目，引用为英文条目与维基数据实体。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级不改动。

entries.summaryZh: 1503年12月29日，贡萨洛·费尔南德斯·德·科尔多瓦率西班牙军队在加里利亚诺河击败萨卢佐侯爵路易多二世指挥的法军，取得决定性胜利。法军被迫撤退，西班牙随后控制那不勒斯王国，意大利战争的天平转向西班牙，此役也是西班牙步兵战术成名的战役之一。
entries.summaryEn: On 29 December 1503 Gonzalo Fernandez de Cordoba's Spanish army defeated the French under Ludovico II, Marquis of Saluzzo, at the Garigliano river, a decisive victory that forced the French to withdraw. Spain went on to control the Kingdom of Naples and the Italian Wars turned in its favour.
entries.significanceZh: 加里利亚诺河之战决定了那不勒斯王国的归属，是西班牙在意大利战争中确立优势的关键胜利。
entries.significanceEn: Garigliano decided the Kingdom of Naples and was the victory that established Spanish predominance in the Italian Wars.
entries.notesZh: 年份修正：索引年1504有误，英文维基正文与维基数据P585均记1503年12月29日（精度到日），故本条采用1503年并只保留年份精度。语种缺口：中文维基百科尚无该条目，引用为英文条目与维基数据实体。坐标、地区与类别沿袭结构化记录，本次升级不改动。

Chinese Wikipedia has no article on the battle, so the citations are the English article and the Wikidata entity. Coordinates, region and category are inherited unchanged.

entries.summaryZh: 1803年9月23日，第二次盎格鲁-马拉塔战争期间，阿瑟·韦尔斯利少将率兵力处于劣势的英军在印度西部阿瑟耶击败道拉特·拉奥·辛迪亚与拉戈吉二世·邦斯勒的马拉塔联军。韦尔斯利后来称这是自己战场上最出色的一役。此战摧毁马拉塔在德干的野战力量，为英国控制中印度铺路。
entries.summaryEn: On 23 September 1803, during the Second Anglo-Maratha War, Major General Arthur Wellesley's outnumbered British army defeated the Maratha forces of Daulatrao Scindia and Raghoji II Bhonsle at Assaye in western India. Wellesley called it his finest battlefield achievement, and the victory broke Maratha field power in the Deccan.
entries.significanceZh: 阿瑟耶战役摧毁了马拉塔联军在德干的主力，是英国扩张为中印度主宰的关键一战。
entries.significanceEn: Assaye destroyed the main Maratha field army in the Deccan and was a decisive step in British dominance of central India.

entries.summaryZh: 1806年12月26日，第四次反法同盟战争期间，拉纳元帅率法军在普鲁士普乌图斯克附近进攻本尼希森指挥的俄军。俄军兵力与火炮占优，经激战后于次日撤退，双方损失都很大，俄军因此在整个冬季陷入组织混乱。此役是拿破仑进军波兰阶段的重要交战。
entries.summaryEn: On 26 December 1806, during the War of the Fourth Coalition, Marshal Lannes attacked the Russian army of Bennigsen near Pultusk in Prussia. The Russians had more men and guns but retired the next day after heavy fighting, leaving their army disorganised for the rest of the winter as the French advanced into Poland.
entries.significanceZh: 普乌图斯克会战使俄军在1806年冬季失去组织能力，为法军控制波兰战场创造了条件。
entries.significanceEn: Pultusk left the Russian army disorganised through the winter of 1806 and eased the French advance into Poland.

entries.summaryZh: 2015年6月3日，顿巴斯战争期间，乌克兰政府军与自称顿涅茨克人民共和国的武装在马林卡及周边交战。共和卫队与皮亚特纳什卡旅一度夺取该镇，乌军随后将其夺回。此役是2015年明斯克协议后顿巴斯前线较激烈的交火之一，显示停火并未真正冻结冲突。
entries.summaryEn: On 3 June 2015 Ukrainian government forces and units of the self-proclaimed Donetsk People's Republic fought in and around Marinka in the war in Donbas. The DPR's Republican Guard and Pyatnashka Brigade briefly seized the town before the Ukrainians retook it, one of the sharper clashes after the 2015 Minsk agreement.
entries.significanceZh: 马林卡战役表明明斯克协议后顿巴斯停火名存实亡，前线城镇继续在双方之间反复易手。
entries.significanceEn: Marinka showed that the Minsk ceasefire had not frozen the Donbas front, where towns like Marinka continued to change hands.

entries.summaryZh: 682年或683年，北非柏柏尔首领库赛拉率罗马-柏柏尔人与拜占庭盟军在维斯克拉（今阿尔及利亚比斯克拉）附近伏击倭马亚将领乌格巴·伊本·纳菲的军队。乌格巴此前率军远征直抵大西洋，归途中在此被歼灭并阵亡，阿拉伯人第一次马格里布远征就此终止。
entries.summaryEn: In 682 or 683 a Romano-Berber force under King Kusaila, with Byzantine allies, ambushed the Umayyad army of Uqba ibn Nafi near Vescera in modern Algeria as it returned from an expedition to the Atlantic. Uqba was defeated and killed, ending the first Arab expedition into the Maghreb.
entries.significanceZh: 维斯克拉战役击杀了倭马亚名将乌格巴，暂时阻止了阿拉伯势力向马格里布西部的推进。
entries.significanceEn: Vescera killed the Umayyad commander Uqba and halted, for a time, the Arab advance into the western Maghreb.

entries.summaryZh: 1582年，在织田信长的持续攻势下，武田胜赖在甲斐天目山一带迎来武田氏的最后抵抗。胜赖先焚毁新府城退入山中，欲投靠旧臣小山田信茂的岩殿城，却被拒于城外，遂与妻子自尽，武田军残部战至最后。武田氏灭亡，信长的统一进程少了一个强敌。
entries.summaryEn: In 1582 Takeda Katsuyori made his last stand at Tenmokuzan in Kai after burning Shinpu Castle and fleeing into the mountains. Refused entry to Iwadono castle by his old retainer Oyamada Nobushige, he killed himself with his wife while the remnant of his army held off the pursuers, ending the Takeda clan.
entries.significanceZh: 天目山之战消灭了武田氏，扫清了织田信长统一日本道路上最有实力的对手之一。
entries.significanceEn: Tenmokuzan destroyed the Takeda clan and removed one of the strongest obstacles to Oda Nobunaga's unification of Japan.

entries.summaryZh: 1801年3月21日，阿伯克龙比将军率英军在埃及亚历山大附近的尼科波利斯抗击梅努指挥的法军，这是法国远征埃及期间的一场重要会战。英军经过数小时激战击退法军，阿伯克龙比本人受致命伤。继任者哈钦森随后围困亚历山大，该城于9月投降，法国在埃及的统治终结。
entries.summaryEn: On 21 March 1801 General Abercromby's British force repelled an attack by Menou's French army near Alexandria, in one of the key engagements of the French campaign in Egypt. The British broke the French after hours of fighting but Abercromby was mortally wounded; his successor besieged the city, which surrendered in September.
entries.significanceZh: 亚历山大战役摧毁了法国在埃及的野战主力，为英军结束法国对埃及的占领奠定基础。
entries.significanceEn: Alexandria destroyed the French field army in Egypt and set up the British conquest that ended French rule there.
